title: Investment Targets as Reference Points
title_zh: 投资目标作为参照点
authors: Petra Vokata, Aleksi Pitkäjärvi, Matteo Vacca, Petra Vokata; Aleksi Pitkäjärvi; Matteo Vacca
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide the first evidence of forward-looking reference points in investor behavior. Combining administrative data on option traders with a stacked difference-in-differences design, we show that investors' propensity to sell options spikes precisely when the underlying asset crosses the strike price, which retail investors frequently select to match their target price. The effect is difficult to explain using the standard disposition effect, nominal returns, salience, option Greeks, or complex option trading strategies. Moreover, the effect is present only for options bought out of the money, for which the strike price acts as a natural target, but absent for options bought in the money, for which it does not. The evidence is most consistent with investors evaluating gains and losses relative to a forward-looking target, in sharp contrast with the backward-looking purchase price widely used in the disposition effect literature. Our findings suggest that standard tests of reference dependence in selling decisions are misspecified when investors evaluate outcomes relative to reference points other than the purchase price.
abstract_zh: 我们首次提供了投资者行为中存在前瞻性参考点的证据。通过将期权交易者的行政数据与堆叠双重差分设计相结合，我们发现，当标的资产恰好突破行权价时，投资者出售期权的倾向会急剧上升，而散户投资者经常选择该行权价以匹配其目标价格。这一效应难以用标准的处置效应、名义收益、显著性、期权希腊字母或复杂期权交易策略来解释。此外，该效应仅存在于价外买入的期权中（此时行权价充当自然目标），而在价内买入的期权中则不存在（此时行权价不构成目标）。这一证据最符合投资者基于前瞻性目标评估损益的行为，与处置效应文献中广泛使用的后顾式买入价格形成鲜明对比。我们的发现表明，当投资者以买入价以外的参考点评估结果时，关于卖出决策中参考依赖的标准检验存在设定偏误。

title: Sovereign Risk and Natural Disaster Shocks: Unraveling the Domestic Yield Curve Response
title_zh: 主权风险与自然灾害冲击：国内收益率曲线反应的解析
authors: Mr. Kangni R Kpodar & Alassane Drabo & Carine Meyimdjui
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of natural disasters on the domestic sovereign yield curve, shedding light on their distinct transmission channels. Using a sample of 72 developing countries during the period 2000-20, and leveraging a newly compiled dataset on domestic treasury bill and bond yields, the findings from the fixed-effects and the local projection difference in difference estimations point to a disaster premium in the pricing of domestic government securities. While natural disasters significantly steepen the yield curve, their effects are confined to short-term maturity debts. In constrast, a worsening in climate vulnerability shifts upward the entire yield curve. Heightened fiscal stress and monetary policy stance emerge as the main transmission channels. These results underscore the importance of integrating resilience building into debt management and fiscal policy frameworks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了自然灾害对国内主权收益率曲线的影响，揭示了其独特的传导渠道。基于2000-20年间72个发展中国家的样本，并利用新编制的国内国库券和债券收益率数据集，固定效应模型与局部投影双重差分估计的结果表明，国内政府证券定价中存在“灾害溢价”。自然灾害显著陡化了收益率曲线，但其影响仅限于短期债务。相比之下，气候脆弱性的恶化则使整条收益率曲线上移。财政压力加剧与货币政策立场成为主要传导渠道。这些结果凸显了将韧性建设纳入债务管理与财政政策框架的重要性。

title: Cashless tax systems: voluntary vs. mandated digital payments in Eswatini
title_zh: 无现金税收系统：斯威士兰自愿与强制数字支付的比较
authors: Fabrizio Santoro, Phindile Masuku, Tanele Magongo
abstract: Abstract The digitalisation of tax payments is a growing policy priority in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in Africa, where revenue mobilisation remains a challenge. This study examines the impact of digital tax payments on compliance, leveraging a 2021 zero-cash-handling mandate in Eswatini. Using administrative tax data, we evaluate two key questions: (i) how voluntary adoption of digital payments affects compliance and (ii) the impact of mandating digital tax payments. We employ a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach for voluntary adoption and a treatment-intensity DiD strategy to assess the mandate’s effects. Voluntary adoption significantly improves compliance, reducing late payments by 19–20% points (25–30 per cent reduction) and increasing payment accuracy (paying the tax liability in full) by 5.6% points (20 per cent), but for strictly digital payments only. Effects on tax amounts paid are less consistent, but the fully controlled broad-digital specification implies an increase of approximately 32%. The mandate, by contrast, eliminated cash payments and is associated with an approximately 17% increase in tax paid on average. While companies pay more taxes, they also worsen their payment accuracy, while individuals are more likely to pay their tax liabilities in full after adoption. These findings highlight distinct compliance patterns between voluntary adopters and those compelled by enforcement. The results underscore the importance of designing digital tax policies that account for taxpayer heterogeneity and behavioural responses to maximise compliance gains.
abstract_zh: 摘要：税收支付数字化是低收入和中等收入国家日益重要的政策优先事项，尤其是在税收动员仍面临挑战的非洲地区。本研究利用斯威士兰2021年实施的"零现金处理"强制令，考察数字税收支付对税收遵从的影响。基于行政税收数据，我们评估两个关键问题：（i）自愿采用数字支付如何影响税收遵从；（ii）强制推行数字税收支付的影响。针对自愿采用行为，我们采用交错双重差分法；针对强制令效果，则采用处理强度双重差分策略。自愿采用显著改善税收遵从：严格数字支付场景下，逾期支付率降低19-20个百分点（降幅25-30%），支付准确性（全额缴纳税款）提升5.6个百分点（增幅20%）。对实缴税额的影响虽不一致，但完全控制的广义数字支付模型显示增幅约为32%。相比之下，强制令彻底消除了现金支付，平均实缴税额增加约17%。企业虽缴纳更多税款，但支付准确性下降；而个人在采用后更可能全额缴纳税款。这些发现揭示了自愿采用者与强制遵从者之间的差异化遵从模式。研究结果强调，数字税收政策设计需考虑纳税人异质性与行为反应，以最大化税收遵从收益。

title: Growth, Firm Scale, and the Energy Intensity of Production
title_zh: 增长、企业规模与生产的能源强度
authors: Kathryn McDonald, Noémie Pinardon-Touati, Conor Walsh
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We uncover a new mechanism that links growth and a decline in the energy intensity of production, observed globally since 1990. Using microdata from India and a causal research design, we demonstrate that the expenditure share of energy declines steeply with firm scale, due both to physical scaling laws and technology investment. Given that average firm size increases with growth, this scale dependence implies that production endogenously becomes less energy-intensive along the growth path. We develop a model of this mechanism in general equilibrium, and quantify significant reductions in aggregate energy intensity as low-income countries like India grow. We conclude with a discussion of the future path of emissions in India.
abstract_zh: 我们揭示了一种新机制，该机制将经济增长与1990年以来全球观察到的生产能源强度下降联系起来。利用印度微观数据及因果研究设计，我们证明企业能源支出份额随规模扩大而急剧下降，这既源于物理规模法则，也源于技术投资。鉴于企业平均规模随经济增长而扩大，这种规模依赖性意味着生产在增长路径上会内生地降低能源强度。我们构建了该机制的一般均衡模型，并量化了印度等低收入国家经济增长过程中总体能源强度的显著下降。最后，我们探讨了印度未来排放路径。

title: Narrative topics and oil
title_zh: 叙事主题与石油
authors: Zhengxu Yan, Qunzi Zhang
abstract: We study whether economic narratives extracted from financial news predict crude oil returns. Using 1.22 million articles from The Wall Street Journal spanning from 1986 to 2022, we apply seeded latent Dirichlet allocation (sLDA) to measure 14 time-varying narrative topics. The empirical results show that narrative topics, including war narratives, outperform traditional predictive models in forecasting crude oil returns. The results remain robust after controlling for standard macroeconomic variables, financial market variables, and uncertainty measures. In addition, we identify the economic mechanisms through which narrative economics contributes to crude oil predictability. Specifically, narrative topics operate by affecting real economic activity, uncertainty, and crude oil supply shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究从财经新闻中提取的经济叙事是否能够预测原油收益。基于1986年至2022年间《华尔街日报》的122万篇文章，我们采用种子潜在狄利克雷分配（sLDA）方法，测度了14个时变叙事主题。实证结果表明，包括战争叙事在内的叙事主题在预测原油收益方面优于传统预测模型。在控制标准宏观经济变量、金融市场变量及不确定性指标后，该结果依然稳健。此外，我们识别了叙事经济学对原油可预测性产生影响的经济机制：具体而言，叙事主题通过影响实际经济活动、不确定性及原油供给冲击发挥作用。

title: The Impact of School Grants on Disadvantaged Students: Experimental Evidence from Romania
authors: de Hoyos, Rafael, Munteanu, Andrei, Pop-Eleches, Cristian
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study analyzes the impact of the Romania Secondary Education Project, which was designed to improve student retention, graduation rates and pass rates on a national end-of-high-school exam for low-achievement high schools in Romania. The program was implemented in three waves, September 2017, September 2018, and September 2020, with eligible high schools randomly assigned to each. The study exploits this staggered implementation to measure the project’s causal impacts on students. The estimates indicate that the Romania Secondary Education Project had no significant impact on (i) student preferences for attending a program high school, (ii) student retention rates, (iii) high school graduation rates, (iv) enrollment in the post-high school baccalaureate exam, (v) baccalaureate exam pass rates, or (vi) baccalaureate exam scores. There was a small increase in girls’ passing rates (3 percentage points). However, there was little heterogeneity in the null effects by grant size, urban-rural status, student achievement levels, town income levels, and type of curriculum taught.

title: Self‐esteem and rational self‐handicapping
title_zh: 自尊与理性自我妨碍
authors: Rachel Mannahan
abstract: Abstract People may create or seek out performance‐inhibiting obstacles to avoid negative feedback about their ability. This behavior, called self‐handicapping, allows agents to attribute failures to self‐imposed obstacles rather than to lack of competence. I model rational agents with preferences for maintaining self‐esteem, and provide sufficient conditions under which they engage in rational self‐handicapping behavior. I consider two policy applications: education and tournaments. Exams with noisier questions strictly increase studying. Policies encouraging particular groups to apply for jobs can result in strategic adjustment, decreasing applications from the targeted group.

abstract: Abstract This paper investigates how capital supply from mutual funds affects municipal bond financing, making three key contributions. First, we introduce an identification strategy using the rule-based update of Morningstar ratings for 5-year-old funds, isolating supply-side effects from fund and issuer fundamentals. The results indicate that exogenous fund flows increase bond issuance probability and decrease yields. Second, these fund flows lead to more issuances when funds and issuers are connected through underwriters, highlighting relationship lending in municipal bond financing. Third, municipal issuers leverage favorable financing conditions for new issuance of revenue bonds, which translates into higher local house prices. (JEL G23, G32, H74)
